name: Clinical Anatomy PhD
summary: Doctoral program at UMMC that trains graduates to teach anatomy in college and graduate settings and to do research in clinical anatomy or anatomy education.
detailsNote: Dates on official pages carry no year, so Fall 2027 is not confirmed. The program page says PhD applicants wanting Spring Recruitment Day must apply by December 15, while the graduate school page says January 15th; the earlier one is safer. Admission model, GRE, English minimums and funding are not stated on the pages reached.

applicationFee.note: The graduate school says a nonrefundable $25 fee must be submitted. The page does not mention fee waivers.

documents: Personal statement (online 'Research Interest and Experience Essay')

english.note: International applicants submit TOEFL, IELTS or PTE-A scores; minimum scores not stated on the pages reached.

requirements.note: Baccalaureate degree in a relevant scientific discipline and GPA of 3.0 or better. The essay covers your motivation for a PhD, prior teaching or research experience, UMMC faculty or research areas of interest, and your career vision five years after the PhD.

international.note: The graduate school's international-students list names this PhD (checked 2026-10-28).

funding.note: No funding information on the program pages. The graduate school says stipends and scholarships are assigned competitively (checked 2026-10-28).
